About WALLART.KE

Art that feels like yours.

WALLART.KE creates handmade wall art for people who want something different. Our 20-inch wall arts are KSh 1,000 each. Tell us what you have in mind if you want a different design or size.

WhatsApp Easy ordering

Pay with M-Pesa.

Enter the amount and the M-Pesa phone number you want to pay from. A real STK Push will ask the customer to confirm the payment and enter their M-Pesa PIN on their phone.

M-Pesa payment

Pay KSh 1,200 securely from your M-Pesa number. Tap the button and an official M-Pesa STK Push will appear on your phone.

Your M-Pesa PIN is entered only in the official M-Pesa prompt on your phone. WALLART.KE will never ask for your PIN.

Send us a photo, colour idea or description of what you want. We'll discuss the design and price with you.
